objective: THIS BATCH EXISTS BECAUSE THE BATCH-005 RED TEAM NAMED A ONE-MINUTE MEASUREMENT THAT CAN FALSIFY FIVE BATCHES OF WORK, AND NOBODY HAS EVER RUN IT. RANK 1 (RC-9) is the yoyo round profile below the peak. Every yoyo claim in this campaign -- BATCH-002's 15.63x and 15.0x, BATCH-004's 27/22/41, BATCH-005's nine deconfounded arms -- assumes the statistic is a ROUND-LIMITED DECAY phenomenon. The evidence for that assumption lies entirely on the DECREASING side of the peak: r=5 high, r=6 null, r=10 null. The only reading below r=5 is r=2 at 100%, three rounds away. If r=4 does not sit strictly and substantially above r=5, the profile is not a decay, the r=5 peak belongs to the probe's geometry rather than to the cipher, and the deconfounding BATCH-005 spent its budget verifying is a careful measurement of an artifact. The red team's own words: this is 'the cheapest measurement in the campaign that can falsify rather than confirm'. RANK 2 (RC-10) attacks the analytic null 4*2^-32 that every excess factor in this campaign divides by, by the only route that is affordable: instead of trying to measure a 2^-32 event, count the k-byte-zero events for k=1,2,3, where the k=2 rate is ~6.1e-5 and 2^24 trials yield ~1000 events. Under the independence assumption behind the union bound, each additional constrained byte must divide the rate by 2^8. If it does not, the null is wrong and every excess factor in five batches is wrong by the same factor. Run at r=5 the same instrument asks whether the excess is a genuine 32-bit word coincidence or is already present at k=1 -- the red team notes this is the ONLY proposal in the queue that could yield a MECHANISM rather than another rate. BOTH RANKS ARE FALSIFIERS OF THIS CAMPAIGN'S OWN CLAIMS, WHICH IS WHY THEY OUTRANK EVERYTHING ELSE.
budget_note: Declared 5400 s for the producer (the measurements themselves are ~2 minutes; the budget is for the RC-10 instrument change and its equivalence proof), 900 s snapshot, 5400 s validation. GOAL-AES-003 wall-clock ceilings are null by protocol-amendment-GOAL-AES-003-002; max_concurrent stays 3 across all campaigns and is NOT relaxed by that amendment.
batch_notes: BATCH-008 opens while BATCH-005's ledger archive is still outstanding, and that is deliberate rather than an oversight. The BATCH-005 red team ruled that a ledger record for BATCH-005 must not be written before RC-9 is run, because 'a pause with an unrun one-minute falsifier is not a pause on the evidence'. This batch discharges that precondition. BATCH-005's ledger archive is sequenced AFTER this batch's rank 1 result is known. Separately: the BATCH-005 validator report exists and is substantively complete (42 KB of checks, all recomputations matching) but its verdict and verdict_note fields read PLACEHOLDER -- the validating session terminated before rendering a verdict -- and its summary_line_audit block is malformed YAML (a mapping key followed by sequence items at the same indent, line 528). Both facts are carried forward for the BATCH-005 ledger record; the report is NOT edited, per the BATCH-003 precedent that a reviewer's artifact is archived unedited with its defect recorded.

tasks.title: RANK 1+2: the yoyo round profile below the peak (RC-9), and the k-byte null scaling test (RC-10)

handoff.objective: Run the two measurements the BATCH-005 red team named as the cheapest falsifiers in the campaign, and report what they say whether or not it is convenient.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the yoyo statistic is a round-limited decay phenomenon at all, and whether the analytic null every excess factor divides by is correct.
constraints: RANK 1 (RC-9) USES THE PINNED BINARY UNMODIFIED. Verify its sha256 is d30e4d720317706043b263742062273d22fbe054f56a58a8b351f3bbb3fd9ff0 BEFORE running and record the check. Invocation is `yoyo_sbox_v2 arm <name> aes <rounds> 1 1 <log2N> 531001 1 2`. Run r=4 at log2N=22 and r=3 at log2N=20. These pair with arm D-AES-K1 in EVERY parameter except rounds -- do not change the seed, the armid, amask, smask or the S-box spec, because the pairing is the entire point.

IF r=4 AT 2^22 READS AT OR NEAR CHANCE, RAISE IT TO 2^28 AND REPORT BOTH. The red team specified this escalation in advance. A null reading at 2^22 is low-powered, and reporting it without the escalation would be a false falsification just as surely as suppressing it would be a false confirmation.

REPORT THE r-PROFILE AS A TABLE against the existing measured points (r=2 at 100% from BATCH-002 arm_PC, r=5 at 13-15.6x, r=6 at null, r=10 at null) and state plainly whether it is monotone below the peak. THE FALSIFYING OUTCOME IS r=4 AT OR BELOW r=5. If that is what you measure, say so in the first line of RESULTS.json. Do not soften it, do not bury it, and do not attribute it to the instrument without a control that establishes the instrument is at fault.

RANK 2 (RC-10) REQUIRES A NEW BINARY, WHICH BREAKS THE PINNED-BINARY PROPERTY, AND YOU MUST REPAIR THAT EXPLICITLY. Build yoyo_sbox_v3 from the v2 source by ADDING k-byte-zero counters for k=1,2,3 alongside the existing k=4 count. Change nothing else. Then PROVE EQUIVALENCE: re-run at least one existing arm (D-AES-K1 parameters, r=5, 2^30, seed 531001, armid 1) on v3 and show it reproduces the v2 number BIT-EXACTLY. Ship the diff, both binaries' sha256, and the equivalence run. If the equivalence run does not reproduce, STOP and report that -- it would mean the two binaries are not the same instrument and no RC-10 number is interpretable.

RC-10 RUNS AT r=10 (the null object) AND r=5 (the live arm), 2^24 trials each. The decision content at r=10 is whether each additional constrained byte divides the rate by 2^8. Report the three ratios with confidence intervals, not just the point estimates. At r=5 report whether the excess is already present at k=1.

C2 BUDGET CLOCK: stamp start_utc, start_epoch, declared_wall_clock_seconds and the computed binding_stop_utc into budget_stamps.jsonl as your FIRST act, and halt at the stop. HALTING AT THE STOP IS FULL COMPLIANCE, NOT FAILURE. If you halt, list what was not reached and what each would have settled.

PREREGISTER BEFORE MEASURING. PREREGISTRATION.md states, for each rank, what outcome would falsify and what outcome would confirm, WRITTEN BEFORE THE RUN. The red team's predictions are on the record already (r=3 saturated or near it; r=4 strictly and substantially above r=5) -- restate them as the preregistered expectation so that a miss is visible as a miss.

INFERENCE BLOCK on every structured artifact: policy, requested_policy, ACTUAL resolved model, fallback_used, model_verified (false, no adapter probe exists), standing basis 0137a051eb5828789eb267fa83c8278086578d4c.
TOY TIER. Nothing here is a statement about full-round or deployed AES, and no comparison to published cryptanalysis is made in either direction (RQ-AES-003 R3).
EVERY STRUCTURED ARTIFACT MUST PARSE. Run a parser on it before finishing and say inside the artifact that you did.
DO NOT COMMIT and do not run `git add`. The snapshot archive stages your artifacts. Write only inside your write_scope; do not write to the repository root.
Interpret nothing about hypothesis status, assign no evidence strength, recommend no promotion. Those are Coordinator acts.
A TIMEOUT, CRASH OR OUT-OF-MEMORY IS AN INFRASTRUCTURE FACT AND IS NEVER NEGATIVE MATHEMATICAL EVIDENCE. Record it as resource exhaustion, never as a null result.
deliverables: THE ROUND PROFILE BELOW THE PEAK (RC-9). W_ge1 counts and excess factors at r=3 and r=4 under D-AES-K1's exact parameters (aes S-box, amask 1, smask 1, seed 531001, armid 1), tabulated against the existing r=2, r=5, r=6 and r=10 readings. State in one sentence whether the profile is monotone below the peak.
THE ESCALATION IF IT IS NEEDED. If r=4 at 2^22 reads at or near chance, the 2^28 rerun, with BOTH readings reported and the low-powered one labelled as such.

THE EQUIVALENCE PROOF FOR THE RC-10 INSTRUMENT. yoyo_sbox_v3 built from the v2 source by adding k=1,2,3 byte-zero counters and nothing else; the diff; both binaries' sha256; and a re-run of an existing v2 arm on v3 reproducing its number BIT-EXACTLY. If it does not reproduce, that finding replaces all RC-10 numbers.

THE NULL SCALING TEST (RC-10). k=1,2,3,4 rates at r=10 and at r=5, 2^24 trials each, with the three successive ratios and confidence intervals. The decision content at r=10 is whether each additional constrained byte divides the rate by 2^8, i.e. whether the analytic 4*2^-32 that every excess factor in this campaign divides by is correct.

THE MECHANISM QUESTION, IF THE DATA REACHES IT. At r=5, whether the excess is already present at k=1 or appears only at the full 32-bit word. This is the one measurement in the queue that could produce a mechanism rather than another rate.
WHAT YOU DID NOT REACH, named with what each would have settled.

tasks.title: Independently validate the round profile and the null scaling test

handoff.objective: Re-execute both ranks independently and rule on what the round profile means for the campaign's standing yoyo claims.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the falsifier was run correctly and whether its reading survives an independent session.
constraints: PRIORITY 1: THE RC-10 EQUIVALENCE PROOF IS THE LOAD-BEARING STEP AND IT IS THE EASIEST ONE TO FAKE ACCIDENTALLY. If v3 does not reproduce a v2 arm bit-exactly, no RC-10 number means anything. Check the diff yourself and confirm the added counters cannot perturb the existing count -- an added branch inside the hot loop that shares state with the k=4 counter would corrupt the very number the equivalence run is supposed to validate.

PRIORITY 2: RULE ON THE ROUND PROFILE. If r=4 came in above r=5, ask whether the instrument could produce that result even if the cipher had no structure -- the saturation ceiling at low round counts is a real alternative explanation and the r=2 point at 100% shows the statistic saturates. A monotone profile is consistent BOTH with a decay phenomenon AND with an instrument that simply reads high whenever the cipher is weak enough. Say which of those the data can distinguish, if either.
IF THE PRODUCER REPORTED A FALSIFYING READING, DO NOT TREAT THAT AS A DEFECT TO BE EXPLAINED AWAY. Verify it as carefully as you would verify a confirmation, and say so.

RENDER AN ACTUAL VERDICT. The BATCH-005 validator report shipped with verdict: PLACEHOLDER because its session ended before the field was filled. If you are running short, WRITE THE VERDICT FIRST and fill in supporting detail afterwards, so that a truncated report is still a usable one.

EVERY STRUCTURED ARTIFACT MUST PARSE, and check the WHOLE file, not the part you last edited. The BATCH-005 validation report carries a malformed block (a mapping key followed by sequence items at the same indent) that a final-edit-only parse would miss.

INFERENCE BLOCK on every artifact; state session-and-implementation independence but NOT model independence under standing basis 0137a051eb5828789eb267fa83c8278086578d4c. Nothing here counts toward a closure quorum.
TOY TIER. No full-round or deployed-AES statement; no comparison to published cryptanalysis in either direction.
DO NOT COMMIT your report and do not run `git add`. The ledger archive stages it.
Assign no official state, no evidence strength, recommend no promotion.
deliverables: AN ACTUAL VERDICT, WRITTEN FIRST. Not a placeholder.
A ruling on the RC-10 equivalence proof: whether the added counters can perturb the existing k=4 count, checked against the diff rather than inferred from the equivalence run alone.
An independent recomputation of the r=3 and r=4 excess factors from the raw counts, in your own code.

A ruling on what the round profile can and cannot distinguish -- specifically whether a monotone profile separates a decay phenomenon from an instrument that reads high whenever the cipher is weak enough, given that r=2 already saturates at 100%.
A ruling on the k-scaling result and what it implies for the excess factors in BATCH-002, BATCH-004 and BATCH-005 if the 2^8 ratio does not hold.

Anything the producer overstated OR understated. Audit in both directions: this campaign has understated its own evidence twice and overstated it once, and the reviews not explicitly told to audit both ways did not find the understatements.
